summary.text: Chip Brown, a Republican, has represented District 105 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Brown was born and raised in south Alabama, joined the Alabama Army National Guard, and served on active duty with the U.S. Army and U.S. Central Command, including as a military adviser in Kabul, Afghanistan, for NATO-International Security Assistance Force and U.S. Forces Afghanistan.
He has also served as CEO of a security training firm, and was a 2012 Republican candidate for president of the Alabama Public Service Commission.
